The identification is tested against this household's own documented third child, Samuel, born 14 March 1671.
Softens the record-coverage unit's flat 'John's grandson' phrasing to a probable, not proven, identification.

finding.shortLabel: Is the 1693 Samuel Gurney John Jr. and Ruth's Mendon-born son?
finding.statement: Whether the Samuel Gurney who married Sarah Shapley at Boston in 1693 is John Jr. and Ruth's Mendon-born son (b. 14 March 1671) is unresolved. No record names either Samuel's father. The identification is chronologically clean - a Samuel born in 1671 would have been twenty-two in 1693, an ordinary marrying age - and no other Samuel Gurney appears anywhere in the surviving colonial-era record to compete for it, but age and the absence of a rival are not the same as a document naming the connection outright. The identification is probable, not proven.

finding.statement: Samuel Gurney married Sarah Shapley at Boston on 26 October 1693, per the printed Boston vital records (Ninth Report of the Record Commissioners, p. 210) - the only Gurney entry of any generation in the volume.
